coding.note: This is a trained-model technical report. Claims are restricted to the abstract/introduction; standard architecture choices and continued training described later are not presented there as novel contributions. Performance claims are coded OTHER, not as new evaluation methods. Data disclosure is PARTIAL: broad mixture proportions and language distributions are given, but reconstructible source-level data are not. Comparator provenance is MIXED: most scores are copied, while Mistral is rerun for MultiPL-E and MGSM. No independent evaluation of Nemotron-4 itself or training-run counts are reported. Compute is disclosed through hardware and the GPU/time breakdown in Table 2 (approximately 13 calendar days).

scores_copied.quote: and unless otherwise stated we use the numbers published in the reports of the corresponding models.

claims.claim: Introduces Nemotron-4 15B, a multilingual 15-billion-parameter model trained on 8 trillion tokens.
claims.quote:
We introduce Nemotron-4 15B, a 15-billion-parameter large multilingual language model trained
  on 8 trillion text tokens.

claims.claim: Outperforms similarly sized open models in four of seven evaluation areas and is competitive in the others.
claims.quote:
it outperforms all existing similarly-sized open models on 4 out of 7
  downstream evaluation areas and achieves competitive performance to the leading open models in the
  remaining ones.

claims.claim: Achieves leading multilingual capability at its size, outperforming much larger and multilingual-specialized models.
claims.quote:
Specifically, Nemotron-4 15B exhibits the best multilingual capabilities of all similarly-
  sized models, even outperforming models over four times larger and those explicitly specialized for
  multilingual tasks.

claims.claim: Developed as a strong general-purpose model that fits on a single A100 or H100 GPU.
claims.quote:
and coding text and was developed to be the best general-purpose large language model (LLM) that can fit
on a single NVIDIA A100 or H100 GPU.

claims.claim: Achieves better average and low-resource programming-language accuracy than Starcoder and Mistral 7B.
claims.quote:
find that Nemotron-4 15B achieves better average accuracy, and in particular on low-resource programming
languages, than Starcoder (Li et al., 2023), a code-specific model, and Mistral 7B.

compute_disclosed.quote:
Nemotron-4 was trained using 384 DGX H100 nodes; each node contains 8 H100 80GB
SXM5 GPUs based on the NVIDIA Hopper architecture

data_disclosure.quote:
the data blend is split into three different types of data: English natural language data (70%), multilingual
natural language data (15%), and source-code data (15%).

tokens_disclosed.quote: We train Nemotron-4 15B on a pre-training dataset consisting of 8 trillion tokens.

rerun.quote: Results for Mistral are from our runs of Mistral in the same setting as Nemotron-4.
